items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I love Wynton, but please, don’t tell me what to do musically.

ctx.x: I love Wynton, but please, don’t tell me what to do musically. You do what you do, and I’ll do what I do.
I’m hoping those pernicious influences are diminishing. I don’t think it’s . . .
